articles.title: Worrying Sign Spotted as Mitch McConnell Finally Reemerges After 92 Days
articles.description: Evan Vucci/Reuters Mitch McConnell was spotted with a large, concerning bruise on his hand in the 84-year-old senator’s first public appearance in 92 days. There has been rampant speculation about the health of the Kentucky Republican, who had disappeared from view since being hospitalized in mid-June after apparently losing consciousness following a fall. On Monday, McConnell was wheeled into the Capitol from his D.C. home, where he had been recovering after his discharge from hospital, and told reporters it was time to “finish the job.” Read more at The Daily Beast.
